items.title: The AI Researcher Who Just Quit Anthropic Says It’s ‘Crunch Time for Humanity’
items.summary: Jacob Coxon talks to WIRED about the “mini Manhattan project” inside Anthropic, the problem with alignment, and why AI labs have just a few years left to make their systems safe.
items.author: Maxwell Zeff

items.title: San Francisco Orders Meta to Stop ‘Allowing’ AI Child Abuse Ads
items.summary: The City Attorney’s Office has asked Meta to explain how the harmful ads repeatedly ran on Facebook and Instagram. The company claims the ads are not under the city’s jurisdiction.
items.author: Matt Burgess

items.title: I Let an AI Agent Hack All My Gadgets—and I’d Do It Again
items.summary: After I removed the safety guardrails from a powerful open-source model, it found vulnerabilities in my household devices and hacked into a PC. But it also told me how to make everything a lot more secure.
items.author: Will Knight

items.title: A Stealth Startup Thinks It Just Hacked the Memory Shortage
items.summary: Kepler Computing claims a new approach to chip design—and a proprietary material—can help end the supply bottlenecks that have sent memory prices surging.
items.author: Lauren Goode
